item.title: Wizards of the Coast is hosting a preview panel at MagicCon Atlanta, showing off all the sets coming to Magic in 2027. While we know of most of the in-universe sets coming to the game next year, the real mystery is the two yet-to-be revealed Universes Beyond crossover sets.
item.description:
Wizards of the Coast is hosting a preview panel at MagicCon Atlanta, showing off all the sets coming to Magic in 2027. While we know of most of the in-universe sets coming to the game next year, the real mystery is the two yet-to-be revealed Universes Beyond crossover sets.
We're watching the stream live, and we'll keep this article updated with all the latest announcements.
Now two puppets have taken the stage for the "Squen and Cragg Show" to kick off the next chapter of the preview event.
They weren't able to show off much more information about the show, but I definitely can't wait to watch it myself. The art looks incredible.
Magic TV Show Gets A Title
It sounds like the Magic show isn't going to just focus on one world, but rather a whole collection of different planes, which is true to the card game. It's called "Magic the Gathering: Planeswalker" and it's coming out in 2027.
The Magic show will be animated and it's going to be about some of the Planeswalkers. "What we have to go off of is thousands of worlds" "It's not just world-building, it's worlds-building."
Here it is, the series! We've known there's been a Magic The Gathering Show coming for a while, and now we're going to hear more.
There will also be a Planeswalker Encyclopedia coming out in September 2027.
Wizards of the Coast will also be releasing an in-universe novel, The Incoming Student's Guide to Strixhaven, and will be a guide to the schools of the magic school.
They're doing a segue into something called Magic the Gathering Publishing. They're opening by talking about Omens of Chaos, that was sold alongside Strixhaven. There are apparently new Magic novels coming at some point, which is awesome, because they've been relying on online-published short stories for a while.
Initially, there is a comic series called 'Untold Stories' and the next issue is going to be based on Chandra Nalaar. There will also be about Mage of Zhalfir, and that will probably come out around the Zhalfir set that'll be coming out in late 2027.
There will also be a novel "Kamigawa Moon Over the Neon City," and it comes with a promo old-border Command Tower.
"Make some noise for whales" Indeed.
Rosewater says they also wanted to show off the 'magic of the underwater', and to do that, they made a new lotus! It's Abyssal Lotus, and it's basically a Black Lotus as long as you have 8 permanents in your graveyard.

item.title: The next map confirmed for Crazy Taxi: World Tour is India, boasting three different zones that celebrate the country’s many cultures and hallmarks — and yes, Bollywood films make an appearance.
item.description:
The next map confirmed for Crazy Taxi: World Tour is India, boasting three different zones that celebrate the country’s many cultures and hallmarks — and yes, Bollywood films make an appearance.
Crazy Taxi: World Tour will boast five international maps: the US West Coast, Germany, Japan, Brazil, and finally, India. The India map will feature three distinct zones, labeled City, Countryside, and Industrial.
The City zone is all hustle and bustle, with vibrant marketplaces, nightlife, and architecture. The Country zone is where you can find ancient temples and zoom through the natural landscape, while the Industrial zone takes players on a tour of its trade and commerce hubs, as well as a look at one of the world’s oldest trains.
The game’s official trailer for the India map even teases that players might find themselves on the “set of a Bollywood film,” showing a passenger holding a camera who appears to be a movie director.
This is the latest news to come from this highly-anticipated installment in Sega’s beloved arcade racing game after a closed beta test gave fans a hint at what its multiplayer mode might look like. A signup website for the test says players could participate in two different modes: Pickup Race and Cops ‘N’ Cabbies.
In the Pickup Race mode, up to 6 players compete to drop off as many passengers as possible within a specific time limit and earn as much cash as they can. In Cops ‘N’ Cabbies, two teams of players face off against each other, with one being cabbies and the other being cops hot on their trail.
In addition to multiplayer, the game also has a story mode that follows its main character, Axel, as he chases a gang of international car thieves across the globe to recover his stolen ride, bussing passengers across each country along the way.
We got the chance to preview Crazy Taxi: World Tour back in August. IGN’s Scott White praised the game for its “simple-yet-exciting sort of fun that arcade games excel at, that makes you want to just keep playing,” calling it an “almost refreshingly uncomplicated palette cleanser free of skill trees, crafting systems, and the other chaff that seems to be in every game you play nowadays.”
Crazy Taxi: World Tour launches in early 2027 on Xbox X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC.
Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze.

item.title: Marvel has confirmed the lineup of heroes that Anthony Mackie's Captain America will lead into battle when Avengers: Doomsday premieres next month.
item.description:
Marvel has confirmed the lineup of heroes that Anthony Mackie's Captain America will lead into battle when Avengers: Doomsday premieres next month.
Which portion of the big team-up movie's ensemble cast will fall specifically into the Avengers camp was confirmed by Empire. During an interview with some of the movie's cast and crew, the minds behind the Marvel Cinematic Universe talked about what each hero is bringing into the fight and which camp they have ultimately fallen into.
With so many different teams from across the MCU multiverse to keep track of, you may have been a bit confused about who was fighting who and which superpowered being was on whose side. For Mackie, returning as Captain America means leading a new team, and that team now officially encompasses him, Falcon (Danny Ramirez), Ant-Man (Paul Rudd), Thor (Chris Hemsworth), and Shang-Chi (Simu Liu).
Hot Toys' Avengers: Doomsday Figures - Image Gallery
The full team includes faces new and old as Earth's Mightiest Heroes band together to fight off Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom. It'll be far from Mackie's first rodeo as Sam Wilson, but donning the Captain America mantle represents a completely new moment not only for himself but for the characters he's leading. He opened up about the role change during the interview.
"In Endgame, Steve gave him the shield and says, 'You need to be the leader of the Avengers,'" he said. "Now you get to see more of him leading the charge with everyone into battle."
Although we know little about what exactly Doctor Doom's master plan entails, we do know that the primary Avengers team will have some help. Classic X-Men characters and the recently established Fantastic Four will be there to help, too, as will the motley crew of half-heroes known as the New Avengers. The group will almost certainly clash with the classic Avengers lineup, with wild cards like Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) sure to throw a wrench into things, too.
Ranking Phase Five of the MCU
There's… a lot going on in the MCU, but Avengers: Doomsday will give everyone a chance to get their act together. Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige also explained what kind of team viewers can expect.
"We're coming out of years of seemingly no organized Avengers team, and that's exactly when they face these incursions," he said, referencing a post-credits scene from the recently released Avengers: Endgame Encore. "That’s always fun, to put your heroes on the back foot."
How are you feeling about the future of Marvel post Avengers: Doomsday?

item.title: A collector has discovered and authenticated what's believed to be the only surviving, playable copy of PokéPark Fishing Rally, a temporary fishing minigame that was only available to play via wireless download at PokéPark in Japan in 2005.
item.description:
From May to September 2005, guests at PokéPark — a theme park in Nagoya, Japan centered on Nintendo’s world-famous monster-catching game franchise —could take part in an especially unique, limited-time gaming experience available only for attendees.
This experience was centered around a game called PokéPark Fishing Rally, a fishing minigame that staff wirelessly transferred to guests’ DS handheld consoles via Download Play stations set inside the Park. The game itself was only available on players’ consoles for a 12-hour period after being downloaded, and would erase itself if the DS was powered off. It featured a slew of catchable Water-Type Pokémon, as well as multiple fishing locations and even cameos from non-catchable Pokémon.
Players would compete with other attendees to fish out Pokémon in special events, contests, and organized activities. Surviving photos taken at the Park show that leaderboards were displayed to help competitors keep track of their progress. It’s been twenty years since then, and Nintendo’s unique PokéPark Fishing Rally game had all but faded from the public consciousness… until now.
The Best Pokémon Spin-off Games
In July 2026, a player posted an eBay listing for a physical development cartridge of PokéPark Fishing Rally that contained a leaderboard of past attendees’ scores. At first, it was believed to be the only surviving cartridge for this extremely specific title — but now, another collector has come forward with a playable copy of the full game.
Daniel Qudari, an avid collector and Pokémon enthusiast, approached IGN with evidence showing that he is in possession of a functioning PokéPark Fishing Rally cartridge, which is capable of transmitting the game to other DS consoles through Download Play.
To prove that his find was legit and that it actually worked, he sent us exclusive photos and videos showing him running the game on a DS handheld, as well as sending it to other DS consoles that were able to play it. In fact, his discovery was so monumental that he sent it to PSA for authentication, which catalogued and encapsulated the cartridge for posterity.
"I have come across things considered lost media several times in my career. However, this is the first time I have encountered it from a franchise as societally and personally important as Pokémon is. It was an honor and a privilege to experience this game first-hand,” Head of PSA Video Games, Claire Shelton, told IGN in an exclusive statement.
“We are always proud to play a role in documenting, authenticating, and encapsulating unique pieces of video game history such as this. Our involvement allows the item to continue existing and potentially transact with full confidence to any collector, assuring them that this unique piece is assuredly one of the only ways to interact with this formerly lost media piece of Pokémon history."
“PokéPark had some incredible attractions in 2005, and PokéPark: Tsuri Taikai DS, also known as PokéPark Fishing Rally DS, made the experience even more immersive. Fans could catch Pokémon in 3D on their Nintendo DS as they explored the park and entered contests for a chance to win prizes. Imagine being one of those kids and finding out years later that the game you played that day had become a piece of lost Pokémon media,” Qudari said in a separate statement to IGN.
PokéPark Fishing Rally Game & Merchandise
“Pokémon started with video games and grew into a world of manga, trading cards and anime. That’s why preserving a game like this means so much to me. After years of fans wondering if it would ever be playable again, it felt surreal to turn on my DS and spend a quiet moment fishing, then feel that rush when I reeled in a Gyarados. For a moment, I got to feel what it must have been like to play it at PokéPark in 2005.
“What fascinates me is that visitors at PokéPark could download the game wirelessly to their own Nintendo DS back in 2005. With this cartridge in my DS, I can recreate that experience today. I can send the full game directly to someone else’s DS through Download Play, without needing a download station.”
Due to the game’s purposefully temporary nature, and the fact that it was never publicly released or officially distributed, it was generally assumed that nobody would ever get to play PokéPark Fishing Rally again. Qudari did not share exactly how he came into possession of this game, but his discovery is extremely exciting, regardless — and it isn’t the only piece of PokéPark memorabilia he’s collected.
Qudari also shared images and videos of various magazines, brochures, and even merchandise from the PokéPark experience, one of which advertises a Summer Vacation Challenge. In the challenge, the first 200 people to catch a specific ‘target Pokémon’ would earn a special Nintendo DS scratch guard as a prize. A decorative fan was also on offer with advertising for the activity.
If you're so inclined, you can read one woman's firsthand account of her time at PokéPark on her blog, where she recounts her boyfriend's one-in-a-million Shiny Magikarp catch. She even included a photo to commemorate the moment, which, as Qudari puts it, must have felt like "winning the lottery." As most shiny hunters will know, repeatedly restarting your device is a common tactic to increase your chances at snagging a shiny 'mon; given that this game would literally delete itself if that happened, the odds of coming across such a find in such a short amount of time is nothing short of a miracle, and a good example of how special PokéPark was.
This is the latest rare Nintendo find to make headlines after a collector came upon a box of 97 sealed copies of an unreleased version of Super Mario Bros. Duck Hunt earlier this year.
Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze.

item.title: Just a couple days after Blizzard changed the way gold was earned in max-level quests WoW Forever, the company has implemented a weekly quest with loot-box-style gold reward. And players don't love it.
item.description:
Just a couple days after Blizzard changed the way gold was earned in max-level quests WoW Forever, the company has implemented a weekly quest with loot-box-style gold reward. And players don't love it.
Max level players have found a quest in Booty Bay called 'In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities,' which is offered each week, according to Wowhead. There is potential that the quest will rotate to different high level dungeons, but so far, for the two weeks Forever has been out, it's pointed players at Dire Maul, where they have to collect three items. The quest rewards a little bag that can drop one of four items at random that are worth either 10g, 20g, 40g, or 100g.
But while this is a way to get gold in a game where money is scarce, it is rubbing a lot of players in the community the wrong way. For a lot of people, it reminds them of retail WoW, which is built on top of piles and piles of weekly quests to pump additional gold into the economy.
World of Warcraft: Forever Screenshots
WoW YouTuber Bellular posted the Wowhead link on X / Twitter, captioned simply by "uh what," and followed that up with some criticisms of the new weekly quest. He said: "Retail slop, kill! The way to generate gold is crafting, gathering, selling items. Want to do UBI? Make it sneaky via those means. Don’t show the hand of the designer so clearly." Bellular then tagged Blizzard associate production director Clayton Stone and added: "(pardon the spicy language - some genuine feedback) Let the player earn organically through game systems, not by making content a hoop to jump through."
But it's not just Bellular who's upset at the weekly quest. It's a similar sentiment over on Reddit, where ThatOldGuy7863 simply said: "dear god not weeklys." Meanwhile, drtakhs added: "F**k weeklies and dailies. I’ve been pretty happy with all the decision so far and the thought process behind them was reasonable. Now, what is this? Who wants this? No dailies, no weeklies and no FOMO bulls**t are among the most important things that make classic feel… well like classic…"
However, there may be an explanation for Blizzard's move here. EvadableMoxie suggested a repeatable quest for 100 gold "is aggressively anti-bot."
"It reduces the biggest benefit that bots have, the ability to run 24/7 by frontloading gold rewards," the continued. "This of course does not make bots useless but it reduces their advantage while letting players focus on other things than grinding out gold."
Blizzard has long struggled with bots messing with the economy in every version of World of Warcraft. In the beta, the company had to come down hard on people who were buying and selling gold, which is a direct consequence of botting. Simply put, it's not hard to program a bot to crawl zones for you and gather mining, herbalism or other materials to sell en masse on the auction house. A weekly quest that rewards gold could help players that don't have the time to compete with bots dumping industrial amounts of crafting materials keep up.
But players aren't mad that Blizzard is adding a way to earn gold. Rather, it's the addition of a weekly quest, that encourages players to log on every single week for fear of missing out on an injection of gold. This sort of repeatable quest also wasn't in the original game, with most types of daily and weekly quests not being added until The Burning Crusade.
This is just the latest change as Blizzard tries to nail down the identity of WoW Forever. While there are some parts of the original game that the company has stood firm on, like group tagging, there is an ever growing list of gameplay systems that Blizzard is actively tweaking in Forever, like Dungeon Experience and now, gold rewards.
World of Warcraft Forever or Retail?

item.title: Sony has revealed that God of War Sons of Sparta is coming to PS4 next week, and it's bringing two new modes with it.
item.description:
Sony has revealed that God of War Sons of Sparta is coming to PS4 next week, and it's bringing two new modes with it.
The unexpected update for this year's action platformer prequel was announced in a PlayStation.Blog post today. In it, Sony confirmed plans to bring Kratos' earliest adventure to the last-gen console starting midnight local time November 16.
It's more than a surprise bonus platform, too, as developer Mega Cat Studios has promised two new modes that will be available on both PS4 and PS5: Hermes Mode and Erebus Mode. The former is described as a "race against the clock" that features speedrunning tools like a split-based timer and a persistent scoreboard. The latter is a one-hit-kill mode that affects both Kratos and his enemies.
God Of War Sons of Sparta Screenshots
Sony and Mega Cat tell God of War Sons of Sparta players that they'll be able to select their mode when starting a new game and selecting a save slot. Game modes can't be changed once selected. Hermes Mode, specifically, is activated only after beating the game once through and after players input the following code: Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, L1, R1, Touchpad. It's unclear if unlocking Erebus Mode has a similar old-school cheat code-esque requirement.
God of War Sons of Sparta takes one of PlayStation's most popular exclusive franchises and scales it down to let players control Kratos at a much, much earlier point in his life in ancient Greece. Shadow-dropped back in February of this year as an experimental chapter of the story for PS5, its story returns to an era fans have longed for with original Kratos actor Terrence 'T.C. Carson back in the booth.
"Every legend has a beginning – before he was a God, before he was a father, Kratos was a young Spartan!" an official story description said. "Experience an untold chapter in Kratos’ journey set during the harsh years of Spartan training alongside his brother Deimos. Through endless trials, their minds, bodies, and hearts have been molded to become Spartan soldiers for whom duty and honor mean everything. After a fellow cadet goes missing, Kratos and Deimos vow to find him and embark on an adventure that will put their training and Spartan spirit to the test."
God of War 20th Anniversary DualSense PS5 Controller
God of War Sons of Sparta was unable to generate the same level of hype the series' more recent entries have been known for. Despite the surprise of getting a new God of War game without any of the build-up, the prequel side-scroller generally received middling reviews from critics and fans. IGN gave it a 6/10, calling it "a pretty mediocre Metroidvania" that failed "to meet the high bar set by the titans of the genre."
Franchise creator David Jaffe was less than impressed with God of War Sons of Sparta when it launched. In a video posted at the time, he said a 2.5D God of War game is "the kind of game I've always wanted" but ultimately said it was an experience he did not like and did not recommend. He even went as far as to say, "This is not God of War."
"I wanted to make a video more about what are they thinking, like what the f*** were they thinking?" Jaffe explained. "It's not a bad game by any means, it's fine, it controls decently... but to me the more fascinating part of this is, why is this in existence? I don't understand."
What Do You Think of God of War Laufey?

item.title: Shortly after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a scandal involving multiple affairs and international espionage allegations, some employees of the company rallied to demand his reinstatement.
item.description:
Shortly after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a scandal involving multiple affairs and international espionage allegations, some employees of the company rallied to demand his reinstatement.
Nvidia's Board of Directors and the FBI launched an investigation into the 63 year old after he admitting having an affair with a woman alleged to have been a Chinese spy. The New York Times then reported that Huang had a second affair with an executive at his own company. It has since been reported that Huang had an affair with yet another Nvidia employee.
Nvidia provides advanced computer chips for everything from video games to cloud servers, but in recent years it has focused on the AI industry. Off the back of the enormous demand for memory to power data centers, Nvidia has become the world’s second-most valuable company, worth more than $4 trillion. However, stocks in the company fell on the news. Meanwhile, U.S. lawmakers on Capitol Hill have said Huang has indicated he is willing to appear before Congress for questioning.
Nvidia GeForce RTX 30-Series Reveal
In the hours after Huang's dramatic exit, a 'suggestion box' post on Nvidia's internal message board urging the company's Board of Directors to retain the CEO took off, getting around 1,600 comments, according to Wired. A majority of those comments were in support of reinstating Huang, and largely expressed sentiments that the Nvidia co-founder was instrumental to Nvidia's success over the last 33 years.
The comments themselves ranged from one employee saying, "If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss," to, "We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance."
Nvidia employees have also taken to social media to voice support for Huang. Gavan Woolery, a senior research scientist at Nvidia, posted on X / Twitter: "Jensen Huang rescued me from probably living in debt the rest of my life. I was told I was one of just three hires that he approved during the pandemic, during a hiring freeze." Woolery added: "His personal life is frankly none of my business. But as a leader, I have yet to meet a better one. Ousting him is financial suicide, and I can only assume there is a hidden ulterior motive because I can't fathom any other reason for destroying the company's value."
Bryan Cantanzaro, VP of Applied Deep Learning Research and one of the people who helped invent DLSS, took to social media to say: "I'm terribly sad @JensenHuang is no longer leading @nvidia. Thank you Jensen. For the tireless work, for the focus, for the wisdom, for the support, for the vision, for the chance you gave me to do my life's work @nvidia."
Nvidia's employees are clearly fiercely loyal to the exiting CEO. According to a Blind survey of Nvidia employees conducted by Investing.com, 88% of workers thought Huang should have stayed on. That's contrasted with a seperate poll among a wider base of professionals outside of Nvidia, where support for Huang sat at just 60%.
It's not just employees that support Huang, though. Elon Musk has spoken out in support of him, as has Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, who tweeted yesterday: "A sad day for Nvidia, developers, America, and all humanity. Jensen founded and ran one of the few companies to reach a massive scale while driving massive continued innovation and ubiquity, while others fell into the trap of ever-increasing extraction."
However, due to the amount of heat that Jensen Huang's various affairs have brought down on Nvidia, it's unlikely that he will be reinstated. Instead, Nvidia's board has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO until a permanent successor has been found. Regardless, none of this bodes well for the gaming hardware that Nvidia's current AI empire was built on top of.
Photo by Joel Saget / AFP via Getty Images.
Has the RAM crisis stopped you from upgrading or buying a PC?

item.title: In yet further evidence of the lengths Rockstar has gone to in order to pack GTA 6 to the brim with content, we have our first look at an animated TV series you can watch in-game.
item.description:
In yet further evidence of the lengths Rockstar has gone to in order to pack GTA 6 to the brim with content, we have our first look at an animated TV series you can watch in-game.
The DiscussingFilm X / Twitter account posted a teaser for Macca & Friends, a cartoon Rockstar created for GTA 6’s Weazel television network, which is also found in both the 3D Universe and HD Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series.
Exclusive first look at ‘MACCA & FRIENDS’.The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida. Coming November 19 on WEAZEL. https://t.co/yLpn1i3ihX
Macca & Friends has big Adult Swim vibes. It stars Pinche, a crab landlord who is going to kick out Macca the alligator if he doesn’t pay rent. There’s a talking sun, lots of other talking animals, and a police station. “The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida,” reads the description.
Reaction is a mix of disbelief that GTA 6 has an entire cartoon in the game itself to watch, and growing hype ahead of its November 19 release date. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson recently told The New York Times that it took him about 80 hours to finish the game back in February. He noted that playthrough included the main story and some "optional goals with narrative ramifications," so it's unclear if he sat down to watch some in-game telly. Still, that is a sizable length regardless. For comparison, GTA 4 and 5 are around 30 hours long, while Red Dead Redemption 2 is around 50-60 hours. So, that means GTA 6 will be the longest of Rockstar's games to date.
GTA 6 Launch Screenshots
Indeed, an in-game TV series is exactly the kind of thing fans have come to expect from Rockstar, which operates on another level to most, if not all triple-A video game companies. We know GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make, but it is considered to be the most expensive video game of all time.
Rockstar has insisted GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make, countering an online rumor, but it’s still probably the most expensive video game of all time. A recent Bloomberg report confirmed that Rockstar Games now has 4,711 staff across 12 offices, up from the 2,441 staff it had when Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in 2018. The company has doubled in size over the last eight years, which will have increased costs significantly. But it also means Rockstar is able to do things like this cartoon, which for many fans won’t be of interest, but for some will be a fun distraction.
Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier said in a video accompaniment to his making of GTA 6 article that Rockstar told him of a scripted system in the game that makes dual protagonists Jason and Lucia — or, it sounds like, any character in the game — exert different amounts of sweat depending on how much effort they’re putting into whatever activity they’re doing. Indeed, Rockstar set up a new studio in Los Angeles packed with writers, producers, and directors, just to make NPCs.
GTA 6 launches on November 19, and we’ve got the global release times so you know when you can start playing. This week, IGN interviewed Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick to talk GTA 6 expectations, Online, and what the next decade looks like. We’ve also got a report on the hunt for information dataminers are currently on following the launch of GTA 6 preload.

item.title: The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, according to former Nintendo marketing leads.
item.description:
The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, according to former Nintendo marketing leads.
Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang, who both worked at Nintendo for over a decade, made the claims on the latest episode of their podcast (as spotted by GamesRadar+). They refuted the idea that Breath of the Wild ruined the Zelda series with its new formula, and instead argued that it actually saved the franchise from a loss of relevance.
It comes as part of a discussion about “new Zelda” versus “old Zelda” — or essentially, the dungeon format versus a complete open world. While there is clearly a demand for the older Zelda games, as evidenced by the hugely successful Ocarina of Time remake, the pair say there is a good reason why Nintendo took them away from us in the first place.
The 10 Best Legend of Zelda Games
“There has been some revisionist history out there lately, about how the Zelda team ripped these away from us at the peak of their popularity,” Ellis says. Yang then expresses her disbelief that fans think this way. “That’s ridiculous. This series was in dire straits. They were selling, like, nothing.” Ellis goes into more detail: “I remember, I was going to the focus groups, and it was a really dark moment when the feedback [was that] the fanbase is dwindling, this is not bringing in new players.” Yang agrees again, saying that it was “depressing,” and that the playerbase was shrinking “smaller and smaller” with each new Zelda release.
Before Breath of the Wild came out in 2017, the Zelda series had seen Wii entry Skyward Sword in 2011, A Link Between Worlds in 2013, and various HD and 3D re-releases. Certainly, Breath of the Wild was an enormous hit, selling an incredible 34.28 million copes on the Switch. Its sequel, Tears of the Kingdom, came out in 2023 and has sold 22.90 million so far.
The Ocarina of Time remake looks like it continues the positive sales trend, becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game so far. The question now is, what will Nintendo do with its inevitable next mainline Zelda game?
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is out now exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2. You can read our review of the game here, or check out our look at the Biggest Changes from the original 1998 game. Be sure to check out our expanding Ocarina of Time Remake Walkthrough for comprehensive guides on each main quest area and dungeon, plus where to get Early Heart Pieces, Early Gold Skulltulas, and Early Item Bag Expansions. If you’re looking for more, don’t miss our complete guides to All Pieces of Heart, All Gold Skulltulas, and All Empty Bottles!
Should the next Zelda return to the more traditional format?

item.title: Jason Vorhees is set to return in a 13th(!) Friday the 13th movie, the first in the horror slasher franchise in nearly 20 years.
item.description:
Jason Vorhees is set to return in a 13th(!) Friday the 13th movie, the first in the horror slasher franchise in nearly 20 years.
Word comes from Deadline, which reports Steve Miner is in place to direct the new movie due out in 2027. Miner directed 1981’s Friday the 13th Part 2, 1982’s Friday the 13th Part III, and 1998’s Halloween H20: 20 Years Later. David Fliegel is writing the script.
The last Friday the 13th movie was the 2009 reboot. New prequel series, Crystal Lake, came out on Peacock in October and finally introduced a key mission component of Jason Voorhees’ history. It became Peacock’s fourth-best scripted-original debut. IGN’s Crystal Lake review returned an 8/10. We said: “Crystal Lake works in large part thanks to Linda Cardellini’s turn as Pamela Voorhees, while showrunner Brad Caleb Kane brings a thorough knowledge of the original source material to the series.”
How to Watch the Friday the 13th Movies in Chronological Order
Deadline said the new film will be financed and produced by the Barsamian family, which controls the franchise through their company Horror, Inc. Horror, Inc. launched the ‘Jason Universe’ as part of a plan to revive the franchise in 2024.
Long-running horror franchises are on something of a tear, in movies, TV shows, and video games. For example, Illfonic's Halloween: The Game came out in September. Saber's Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival came out in October. Mike Flanagan adapted Stephen King's horror classic, Carrie, for a Prime Video series that's getting a Season 2. Apparently Paramount is interested in reviving A Nightmare on Elm Street, too.

item.title: Deadpool Star Ryan Reynolds has acknowledged yesterday's reports that he will get a writing credit on the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday.
item.description:
Deadpool Star Ryan Reynolds has acknowledged yesterday's report that he will get a writing credit on the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday.
Reynolds is listed alongside a variety of other contributors to Doomsday's script via the Writers Guild of America's website, though the extent to which Reynolds (and his Deadpool & Wolverine co-star Hugh Jackman, too) have actually added to Doomsday's dialogue remains to be seen.
Doomsday is primarily written by Marvel veterans Christopher Markus and Stephen McFeely, who previously wrote both Avengers: Infinity War and Endgame. Today, however, Reynolds appears to have verified his additional involvement by issuing a brief but humorous response to the matter.
The Most Surprising Avengers and Marvel Characters Not Announced for Doomsday
In a post on X/Twitter, Reynolds quoted a post revealing that he and Jackman had written parts of Doomsday and added a short clip from Deadpool & Wolverine. The scene sees Reynolds chatting with Matthew Macfadyen's Mr. Paradox, and declaring that he does not read.
The moment is likely just meant as a jokey nod to the fact that yes, in real life, Reynolds can indeed read and write and has done so on various projects. The Detective Pikachu star holds writing credits on Deadpool 2 and Deadpool & Wolverine, and has previously discussed working on a future Deadpool movie also.
https://t.co/0WpMMFfmVD
It's an intriguing situation, as Deadpool and Wolverine have technically not been officially confirmed to appear in Avengers: Doomsday, even though both Reynolds and Jackman have been busy promoting the movie via tongue-in-cheek promos at San Diego Comic-Con and D23 over the summer. Still, fans strongly expect the pair to appear, and leaks point to them having a small but significant presence in the film as various multiverses collide.
How many F-bombs will Kevin Feige let Reynolds sneak into Doomsday's script? There's not long until the movie arrives on December 18 and we find out.
Do you think Deadpool is in Avengers: Doomsday?

item.title: Fans have been left furious by Microsoft's launch of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X console, which sold out within seconds online. Now, scalpers are cashing in.
item.description:
Fans have been left furious by Microsoft's handling of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X console launch, after stock sold out within seconds online.
Social media is awash with reports from players who attempted to purchase one of the company's snazzy translucent green 25th Anniversary consoles from the Microsoft Store, only for stock to sell out before they could finish making their order.
To be fair, Microsoft had previously stated it would only have a "limited number" of consoles to sell at launch. In a social media post earlier this week, the company noted that availability would begin at midnight Eastern time and that quantities and availability would "vary by market and retailer."
Still, numerous fans were left empty-handed, or angered by retailers such as GameStop taking advantage of the low stock situation by selling the $999 console at a huge markup. For a time, GameStop was shifting its stock allocation at the eye-watering price of $4,950, although even this now appears to have sold out.
XBOX Series X25 Limited Edition Console Images
Much of the criticism has been levied against Microsoft itself, however, for only making a small number of consoles available and for not having a better online queueing system available. Some fans have suggested that purchases could have been limited to customers with Xbox accounts to prove their legitimacy and limit bulk buying. This option could have even been tightened further to offer the console first to Xbox's most dedicated fans — perhaps those with older account status, or those who have collected a certain amount of Gamerscore.
Whatever the potential solution, however, Microsoft appears to have just let its stock go on sale via a first-come, first-serve basis. Inevitably, this has lead to numerous consoles being placed upon eBay at a notable markup. Looking online this morning, IGN has seen dozens of Xbox 25th Anniversary consoles that have already been sold through eBay for $1,500, and up to $2,500.
"At this point I don't even care anymore," one Xbox fan wrote in a post on X/Twitter. "I tried back in August, I tried last night and I tried tonight. Yea im upset I cant get one of these due to scalpers but, I just cant find it in myself to care anymore. I love Xbox, but what a mess."
"It's all a joke," another fan added, comparing the launch to Sony's similar PS5 anniversary consoles. "They’re made specifically for bots, scalpers and to be backdoored. No genuine fans actually get these."
"I have been a Xbox loyal fan for 20+ years and I can't even get my hands on this," added another fan. "I stayed up and have been trying to get one since 12pm YESTERDAY. You do nothing for the loyals and let these scalpers and bots take them all. Nothing restocked. When I ended up getting one in my cart the f***ing website just loaded and loaded until it disappeared. Just a f***ing shame. Beyond pissed off rn."
Last month, Xbox boss Asha Sharma insisted that falling sales of Xbox consoles had been hampered by supply constraints, and that there was "more demand than consoles available."

item.title: Dragon Age fans have saved one of the series’ most beloved features: being able to import your world states in each game.
item.description:
Dragon Age fans have saved one of the series’ most beloved features: being able to import your world states in each game.
With the Mass Effect trilogy, this was simple: just play through the series on the same console, and your saves are automatically carried over. The same was true going from Dragon Age: Origins into Dragon Age 2. But by the time Dragon Age: Inquisition rolled around in 2014, a new console generation was upon us, so BioWare had to get creative.
This is when we get the Dragon Age Keep. This website connects to your EA account and keeps track of all the decisions you made in the previous games. Or, you can just input whatever decisions you want manually. You can then import this crafted world state into Dragon Age: Inquisition and see your previous choices reflected in the game.
Every IGN BioWare Game Review
I am sure many of you can already see the problem with this system: it’s an online service that needs to be maintained. True enough, the Dragon Age Keep experiences fairly frequent outages, during which time no one can start a new Inquisition run with their choices carried over.
Now that EA has shut down BioWare, it’s unclear what will happen if the Keep goes offline again, or how long EA plans to keep it going. Thankfully, fans already have a solution, at least if you’re on PC. A couple of modders have released user-friendly ways to adjust the game files so your choices still carry over, even if EA pulls the plug on the Dragon Age Keep.
First up, there’s Thedas World State Studio - Dragon Age Keep Utility by Nexus Mods user anshela. This gives you an offline alternative to the Keep, letting you input your choices in the same tapestry format you would in the online version.
This is much more user-friendly than previous methods of editing your world state on PC. As anyone who has tried will tell you, modding Inquisition is a nightmare thanks to the Frostbite engine, but this tool should make it much more accessible.
The modder says they were already working on this before the BioWare news hit, and the fact that it is ready now is just “good/bad timing." Indeed it is, because the next Dragon Age Keep outage could be the last.
Right now, the mod files have been “quarantined” while Nexus approves the latest version, so it can’t be downloaded just yet. But once it’s up and running again, it should work just fine, judging from the response from users so far.
This isn’t the only mod you’ll need if the servers go offline. The closest thing Inquisition has to New Game Plus lets you port almost all of your unlocks into future playthroughs, but for whatever reason, this also requires the Keep to be up, even though it’s only dealing with things you’ve unlocked in Inquisition.
That is where Thedas Chronicle - World State and Golden Nug Fix by TP1231 has us covered. This will let you access the Golden Nug statue that activates item transfers even if the servers are down. As the name suggests, it will also let you play with your imported world state when the Keep is offline, but you will still need the world state that you made while the servers are up.
While it’s great to see fans get these solutions out before EA potentially pulls the plug, it is no wonder that BioWare didn’t want to risk this happening ever again. Instead, Dragon Age: The Veilguard had us input previous choices in the game itself, so it could be played offline. Granted, we had far fewer options to carry over that time around, much to the frustration of fans, but at least it means we won’t have to go through this again.
In the meantime, BioWare fans are currently fighting to save the studio’s IPs. Most notably, the Save Mass Effect movement has amassed thousands of supporters, as they urge EA to do something with the IP, rather than let the series die.
Rhiannon (she/her) is a freelance journalist who has been in the industry since 2019. She won MCV's Women in Games award in 2025 and adores RPGs. You can follow her on Bluesky at @rhithewitch.

item.title: Fortnite is teasing a big reveal for its upcoming December 5 live event, which will reveal the identity of mysterious new character Captain X.
item.description:
Fortnite is teasing a big reveal for its upcoming December 5 live event, which will reveal the identity of mysterious new character Captain X.
The game has previously employed big-name stars such as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson and Brie Larson to portray notable in-game characters, and appears to be on the cusp of unveiling yet another casting of some significance.
Captain X made their debut at the beginning of Fortnite's current treasure-hunting mini-season, though their motives are currently unclear. As Fortnite's heroes hunt a fresh macguffin, Captain X has seemingly allowed them to make steady progress, while the game's story has suggested the character could also simply be letting players do their legwork instead, before swooping in to steal the prize.
Fortnite Treasure Hunters Images
At the same time, Fortnite itself has introduced a treasure hunting mechanic where players can win a fortnight of free access to the game's lucrative Item Shop — something that has sent concurrent player numbers soaring into the millions (all timed to cushion the blow of GTA 6's launch.)
Whether Captain X turns out to be friend or foe remains unclear, as does their relation to the game's wider storyline. This currently features a roster of surviving heroes from much of the game's past decade returning to face down Geno, Fortnite's uber Big Bad from the days when Epic Games' former creative boss Donald Mustard was still in charge of the storyline.
Should Geno actually be defeated, finally, will Captain X be revealed as the next major threat? Or perhaps they will be a new hero for players to follow, should Jonesy finally fall in battle?
Whatever is the case, Epic Games is clearly now teasing that there's more to Captain X than meets the eye. Last night at the Streamer Awards 2026, Captain X turned up in person wearing a mask to deliver a hand-written note confirming that they would be fully unveiled on December 5 — the date of Fortnite's next Chapter-ending live event.
Genuine question. Who could this possibly be that would be both exciting to see and fitting for Captain X's character. Like, the Foundation being The Rock only worked because there was a year of buildup and a lack of notable names in Fortnite. We have like everyone in the game now.Not even trying to be miserable or anything here, I'm just absolutely lost as to who he(?) could possibly be.
Currently, Captain X has only appeared in-game with their face covered, while their dialogue has been disguised with a heavy voice filter. (Players previously worked out that The Rock was playing a key character pretty quickly from his voice lines, even though he remained masked for almost a year — something that has not yet happened this time around.)
But who is it under the mask? Fans are speculating that the character will be played by a well-known actor or celebrity, with many suspecting that MrBeast has been brought on board. The YouTube star is already available in Fortnite as a character skin, and Captain X's ability to dole out hugely valuable prizes certainly lines up with MrBeast's usual shtick. Other fans have suggested the X is actually a clue this will be a new character played by Elon Musk, which seems extremely unlikely. And even less possibly, others have rounded on the idea that this seemingly generous person is actually President Barack Obama — which would certainly be a booking.
If you can tear yourself away from GTA 6 in time for December's Fortnite live event, we'll find out for sure what's going on, in just under a month's time.
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

item.title: Microsoft is struggling to fix a prolonged systems outage that has hindered access to online services including Outlook and Teams.
item.description:
Microsoft is struggling to fix a prolonged systems outage that has hindered access to online services including Outlook and Teams.
On the upside, AI tool Copilot has also been impacted.
For more than 12 hours, users around the world have been reporting an inability to access email accounts, instant messaging systems, and documents via OneDrive and Office365. No Xbox services are believed to be offline, however.
Microsoft was quick to acknowledge the problem and admit that it was suffering from issues with its server capabilities, with "elevated load across multiple regions." Attempts to solve this were initially unsuccessful, however, as the company reported its fixes were "not taking as expected."
The 100 Best Xbox Games of All Time
"We've monitored the status of the changes applied to improve serviceability and confirmed they're not taking as expected," Microsoft said in a lengthy thread on X/Twitter. "We're identifying alternate workstreams that can be applied to increase capacity in the face of sustained traffic management imbalances."
Hours later, Microsoft seemed to have changed tack and was now trying to carve out the impacted servers completely as it struggled to make progress.
"We're aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact," the company then stated. "We've paused all deployments, we're moving additional traffic off the affected infrastructure, and we're restarting affected servers to return them to service."
Why is this happening? Microsoft has blamed a number of servers becoming "unexpectedly unavailable", adding strain to its remaining capacity, rather than any sudden increase in traffic. That would suggest this is not a targeted DDOS attack, and indeed, Microsoft exec Charles LaManna has confirmed "there is no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity."
We'll update again when there's been further developments. In the meantime, hopefully you're having a quiet day at work or school.
Photo Illustration by Scott Olson/Getty Images.

item.title: GTA 6's fast-food hamburger chain, Burger Shot, is expanding with new locations across Florida starting this weekend thanks to a collaboration with Skinny Louie.
item.description:
GTA 6's fast-food hamburger chain, Burger Shot, is expanding with new locations across Florida starting this weekend thanks to a collaboration with Skinny Louie.
Last month, Burger Shot became available at the Kaseya Center, allowing fans to try the real version of the in-game restaurant during Miami Heat games, courtesy of a partnership with a fast-food joint known as Skinny Louie. The chain is now expanding this activation through its standalone stores across Florida. From November 13 to December 31, stores will feature Burger Shot signage, uniforms, and, of course, a menu themed after items in the game.
You can take a look at the menu and some images of the food below.
GTA 6 Burger Shot x Skinny Louie Collab

GTA 6 Launch Screenshots
All of this just goes to show how big GTA 6 has gotten. There aren't many video game franchises that could completely command and rebrand a chain of restaurants, but GTA 6 certainly has that power. The game is already the most pre-ordered title in the history of Xbox and PlayStation's digital stores, and analysts estimate that the game has generated $1 billion in revenue ahead of launch.
GTA 6 will officially release next week on November 19 and players can start pre-loading right now. Rockstar has also been trickling out small clips of in-game footage, giving players a taste of what's to come when they load in to Vice City next week.

item.title: As part of the Xbox's 25th anniversary celebration at Xbox Fanfest in Seattle today, developer MachineGames confirmed what had long been rumored: that Wolfenstein 3 is in development.
item.description:
As part of the Xbox's 25th anniversary celebration at Xbox Fanfest in Seattle today, developer MachineGames confirmed what had long been rumored: that Wolfenstein 3 is in development.
MachineGames will once again be developing it. Wolfenstein 2: The New Colossus was released to rave reviews in 2017, but MachineGames then put the series on hold to develop 2024's absolutely stellar Indiana Jones and the Great Circle.
But now, Wolfenstein is back on the front burner at the Swedish studio. "Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at Machine Games," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed on X. "One of gaming’s most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more."
Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @MachineGames. One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more. https://t.co/YyX8LrbTvh
MachineGames added on to Sharma's post, which shows a page of the Wolfenstein 3 script, saying simply, "His reputation precedes him," referring to the action described on the script page. "Wolfenstein 3 is in production." The developers also confirmed that actors Brian Bloom (as B.J. Blazkowicz) and Debra Wilson (as Grace Walker) will return via a photo of the pair in the developer's motion-capture studio.
Wolfenstein 3 shouldn't come as much of a surprise. Last year, in an interview with Noclip, MachineGames studio head Jerk Gustafsson said the team had "always seen [BJ's story] as a trilogy," adding: "That journey for BJ, even during those first weeks at [id Software], when we mapped out New Order — we still had the plan for at least [BJ], what would happen in the second one and what would happen in the third one.
"I think that's important to say, because⁠ — at least, I hope ⁠— we're not done with Wolfenstein yet. We have a story to tell."
That's not all that Wolfenstein fans have to look forward to, as the pioneering first-person shooter series is also being developed into a TV series at Amazon. Xbox's official 25th anniversary is this Sunday, November 15.
Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked, and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch. He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan.

item.title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned today amid a scandal involving an affair with a suspected Chinese spy and an executive that reported to him. Now, it's been reported that Huang allegedly had an affair with a second employee.
item.description:
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned today amid a scandal involving an affair with a suspected Chinese spy and an executive that reported to him. Now, it's been reported that Huang allegedly had an affair with a second employee.
Huang allegedly had an intimate relationship with a second employee, according to two sources inside Nvidia and reported by Reuters. However, Reuters hasn't named the second employee, and attempts to reach her were not successful.
This third revelation comes just hours after Huang resigned from Nvidia, following an internal investigation that kicked off on Sunday. Huang himself came out and admitted to one of the affairs in a letter sent to Nvidia staff and obtained by The BBC. Then, following a meeting where Nvidia's board weighed ousting Huang, the former CEO resigned.
Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 – Photos
In the meantime, Nvidia's board has named CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while the company searches for a new leader. Nvidia is considering both internal and external applicants, but there has been talk that Apple Senior Vice President of Hardware Technlogy Johny Srouji is being considered for the role, according to MacRumors.
As for Huang itself, it's not clear where he's going to end up, or what he's going to do going forward. Last night, Elon Musk posted on X that it "would be an honor" to hire Huang... but it's doubtful that he'd end up at any of Musk's companies.
Either way, Huang has been leading Nvidia since 1993, and has seen the company grow from being a niche gaming hardware company to the backbone of the entire AI industry. His resignation is going to send shockwaves throughout the entire tech biz. One of the biggest casualties might end up being PC gaming altogether. After all, Nvidia makes up for a massive 73% of Steam's install base, according to the latest Steam Hardware survey, but the company still dropped gaming from its earnings reports earlier this year. And, now with Jensen's departure, it's unlikely that PC hardware is going to get the same level of support.
Photo by Joel Saget / AFP via Getty Images.
Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. She's been covering gaming hardware for more than a decade for IGN, TechRadar, Gizmodo, PC Gamer and more. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

item.title: Valheim is expanding beyond video games once again, this time with an official comic book series featuring an impressive lineup of talent from Marvel, DC, television, and animation.
item.description:
Valheim is expanding beyond video games once again, this time with an official comic book series featuring an impressive lineup of talent from Marvel, DC, television, and animation.
Developer Iron Gate Studio has teamed up with GUNGNIR Books and MOOD Publishing to bring its Viking survival game to comics, with the first release planned for the first quarter of 2027. The multi-issue series will feature original stories set in the world of Valheim, rather than simply retelling the events of the game.
New Valheim Comic Book Series
The writing team certainly has a pretty impressive portfolio that bodes well for the series. It includes Steve Orlando (Wonder Woman, Avengers), Deric A. Hughes and Ben Raab (Quantum Leap), J. Holtham (The Handmaid's Tale, Supergirl), Brea Grant (12 Hour Shift), Tim Sheridan (Masters of the Universe), and Olan Rogers (Final Space). They're joined by TD Orel, Chris Klian, Andrew Sanders, and GUNGNIR Books founder Matthew Medney.
On the art side, Scott Oakley, Vanessa Del Rey, Lucas Pereira, and Mario Del Pennino are among the confirmed artists, with Mohamad Samah overseeing production design. More talent is expected to be announced.
According to the announcement, the series will explore the mythology of Valheim's mysterious tenth Norse realm, introducing new adventures and perspectives on its gods, monsters, and dangerous environments. Expect plenty of exploration, survival, and presumably some very unfortunate encounters with the local wildlife.
“Valheim is one of those rare worlds that feels like it existed long before we ever discovered it. There are gods, monsters, entire civilizations, and a mythology so rich that the stories we can tell feel almost endless," said Matthew Medney from GUNGNIR Books. "For us, the opportunity to work alongside Iron Gate and MOOD Publishing to bring this universe into comics is extraordinary. And we've assembled an absolute army of creative talent to do it. We're not interested in simply retelling what millions of players have already experienced. We want to explore the legends that haven't been told, the corners of this world that haven't been seen, and create something that feels worthy of the incredible universe Iron Gate built. This is Valheim, and we're going to make it epic."
The comic marks another expansion for Valheim, which has now sold more than 17 million copies worldwide since launching into Steam Early Access in February 2021. The game has already made the jump to tabletop gaming with Valheim: The Board Game, also developed in partnership with MOOD Publishing.
For now, there's no specific release date beyond Q1 2027, and details about individual issues, collectible editions, and how fans can get involved are still to come. In the meantime, Valheim players can look forward to exploring the tenth realm without having to worry about keeping their food buffs topped up. Which, frankly, sounds rather nice.
Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.

item.title: Four minutes of new Fable gameplay has been released by Xbox, showing off more of the game's combat.
item.description:
Four minutes of new Fable gameplay has been released by Xbox, showing off more of the game's combat.
The footage was released personally by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma as part of a larger celebration for the company's 25th anniversary. The gameplay shows off a bunch of combat, highlighting not only standard swordplay, but also ranged attacks and unique moves that can be performed using magic. The gameplay was captured on PC using ultra graphics settings and concludes with the protagonist stumbling upon an incredibly sinister-looking tomb or coffin.
Fable was, of course, meant to have been released this fall. However, Xbox made the smart decision to delay the game to February. Although the team says the delay wasn't done specifically in an effort to avoid GTA 6, it was likely a nice benefit. Microsoft still had plenty of releases this autumn thanks to Modern Warfare 4 and Gears of War: E-Day, so it was wise to give Fable some more room to breathe. The game was announced all the way back in 2020, but has been in some form of development at Playground Games for nearly a decade.
Forza Horizon studio Playground Games is leading the charge on the title, though it has recruited a bunch of talent from around the industry so that it is well-equipped to build an RPG. Fable is one of the most anticipated games on Xbox's slate, partially because it's one of the most beloved RPG franchises out there, and Microsoft is looking for a big win in the AAA space outside of shooters.
Fable is also coming to PS5, as it had been previously announced for the platform. It'll be interesting to see what happens if the game performs well on the platform. Xbox is trying to lean more into exclusivity, but it unfortunately didn't seem to pay off for Gears of War: E-Day. Here's hoping Fable is worth the wait and pays off on Microsoft's investments.
Fable will release on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PC on February 23.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.
